answer: In PoA, sybil resistance follows from bonded escrows: when k coordinated identities equivocate on conflicting messages, correlated penalties scale quadratically, O(k^2), rather than linearly. Upon detection, an exponential multiplier magnifies capital loss across the swarm, while asymmetric depreciation destroys collateral value and deters cheap identity replication. Neither a jetty, pulse, nor prism can conceal shared control.
